A stand-up paddleboard (SUP) experience at Naguri Lake is a gentle eco-tour for heart and body, letting you feel the seasonal natural beauty and peaceful waters of the lake all around you.

【Cost】¥4,000 per person (includes guide, insurance, SUP board rental, etc.)

【Capacity】5 people

【Guide】Staff of Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop

【What to bring】Towel, change of clothes, water shoes if desired (barefoot is fine too)

【Notes】For more information, visit Certified NPO Naguri Canoe Workshop: https://naguri-canoe.co.jp/
location: 集合 名栗カヌー工房（国際興業バス「ノーラ名栗・さわらびの湯」下車徒歩20分、または「河又名栗湖入口」下車25分）
summary: Beginner-friendly SUP experience at Naguri Lake—come as you are and enjoy a relaxing eco-tour!
